hub.headline: Crystal Space is an open-source 3D SDK and game engine written in C++.
hub.next: Rebuild Crystal Space from its public source and record the older dependencies it needs.
hub.what_it_was: Crystal Space is an open-source 3D SDK for Unix, Windows and Mac OS X, with an OpenGL renderer and engine features. The project has been dormant since about 2011.
hub.what_survives: The full source is public on GitHub under the LGPL, with documentation pointers, and the SourceForge project page remains.

name: Crystal Space
summary: Public records now track Crystal Space's SourceForge project registry, GitHub source repository, feature summary, and LGPL metadata.
